title: 04 Modes
subtitle: Edit · Preview · Present, and the tools that look like modes — Studio site and Alligators brand
brief: Ruzne mody edit/preview/present atd. — one mode switch in the Share cluster (Edit · Preview · Present, Viewing for people who can only view or comment) with its own glyphs; Preview is the live canvas (DDR-223); Present runs artboards one by one or the whole canvas (DDR-117). Two toolbars, one per mode (CONTRACT §2, Michal 2026-10-08): Edit makes things inside artboards — Select · Hand · Frame · Shape · Pen · Text · Image · Component · More; Preview is annotation tools only, FigJam-style — Hand · Sticky · Comment · Marker · Arrow · Shape · Text · Stickers · Section; the design stays live. Annotation keys (N C M A E S) in Edit switch to Preview with that tool; esc steps back. Drawn on Studio site (a linked web prototype) and Alligators brand (Combine-kampan, 15 artboards incl. print and video).

artboards.label: 1 · The mode switch, and what each mode shows
artboards.note: Edit · Preview · Present (Viewing for read-only) in the Share cluster; a table of what stays and hides; two toolbars side by side (kit Toolbar edit + annotate) with what each tool does — Edit makes things inside artboards, Preview only marks up the layer above.

artboards.label: 2 · Its own glyphs, words and keys
artboards.note: Mode glyphs vs the tool and menu glyphs they must not borrow; both toolbars with their keys (CONTRACT §2) — N C M A E S in Edit switch to Preview with that tool; the still-proposed mode keys; the amended Menu › View.

artboards.label: 3 · Edit — set up where a click goes
artboards.note: Selecting a button shows its On click (Go to Pricing) and the link on the canvas; ⌥ measures the gap to a neighbour.

artboards.label: 4 · Image — a photo into a frame
artboards.note: Image (I): Assets opens on the left; a photo dragged onto the hero frame fills it, cropped to fit; ↵ places on a selected frame; on empty canvas it becomes its own frame.

artboards.label: 5 · Component — a Button from the Design system
artboards.note: Component (⇧I): Studio site system's components; Button › Secondary placed into the CTA row, where it joins the row and stays linked to the Design system.

artboards.label: 6 · Edit → Preview, in motion
artboards.note: Three frames at 0 / 40 / 220 ms on --dur-panel and --ease-out: panels fold, Edit's tools sink out and Preview's annotation tools rise in (kit ToolbarMorph), the camera eases onto the same artboard.

artboards.label: 7 · Preview's toolbar — annotation tools only
artboards.note: The toolbar morph as a filmstrip (0 / 40 / 140 / 220 ms, kit ToolbarMorph): Edit's set (Select … Component) sinks out, a different FigJam-like set rises in a size bigger; N in Edit opens Preview with Sticky and its colours; keys H N C M A R T E S.

artboards.label: 8 · Previewing Homepage
artboards.note: The live canvas, marked up: artboards work in place, a sticky, a marker loop and an arrow sit on the annotation layer; the toolbar is annotation tools only; esc returns to Edit.

artboards.label: 9 · Followed a link to Pricing
artboards.note: A link to another canvas opens it in Preview on the linked artboard; ‹ Homepage goes back; comments still show.

artboards.label: 10 · Preview on a canvas with no links
artboards.note: Combine-kampan: videos play, the web page scrolls in its artboard, you pan across all 15; nothing can be moved.

artboards.label: 11 · Present, and its small menu
artboards.note: Present starts from the selection (⌥⌘↵); the menu offers the start (⇧⌥⌘↵), the whole canvas, presenter view, order and notes, and a live link.

artboards.label: 12 · Present lifts the artboard out of the canvas
artboards.note: Three frames at 0 / 40 / 280 ms: the artboard rises from its slot into full screen; esc sets it back exactly where it was.

artboards.label: 13 · Full screen — 3 of 14
artboards.note: Only the work; → ← and space step in canvas order; L gives a ringed pointer in your presence colour; controls fade.

artboards.label: 14 · A 9:16 video plays inline
artboards.note: Reels plays with sound when its turn comes, pillarboxed; a click pauses; → or space moves on mid-clip.

artboards.label: 15 · Present the canvas — pan freely
artboards.note: Today's Presentation mode kept: no chrome, no pins, no annotations; pan and zoom the artboards where they live; esc returns to the same view.

artboards.label: 16 · Presenter view on the Mac
artboards.note: Now, next, notes and clock on the Mac; the order is drawn as the canvas itself, numbered, with the skipped banner dimmed.

artboards.label: 17 · Watching from a link — and looking back
artboards.note: A cloud viewer followed Tereza, pressed ← and drifted to 5 of 14; the bar offers one action, Catch up.

artboards.label: 18 · Pins, a thread, a mention
artboards.note: C in Edit switches to Preview with Comment in hand; the thread opens beside the pin; Resolve; Open / Mine filters; @ suggests people.

artboards.label: 19 · Someone who may only comment
artboards.note: Can comment: Preview's toolbar cut to Hand and Comment (kit Toolbar mode=annotate only=[hand, comment]); the first slot reads Viewing; editing tools and AI hidden, not greyed; Ask to edit. Uniformy-2027's real 16:9 digital boards.

artboards.label: 20 · Annotate in Preview — AI reads the layer
artboards.note: In Preview with Sticky picked (green): stickies, arrows, a section and a highlight on their own layer above the live design; AI bolds the date the sticky asked for and asks when unsure.

artboards.label: 21 · Inspect “Book a call”
artboards.note: ⌘-click in Preview: the switch stays, an outline (no handles) marks the element; gaps on ⌥; Copy code, Edit ↵, Handoff; CSS under Advanced.

artboards.label: 22 · AI changes the artboard you're clicking through
artboards.note: The artboard under your pointer holds still and AI's new hero lands when you move off; Tablet updates live.

artboards.label: 23 · A view-only link, in a browser
artboards.note: Can view opens in Preview (DDR-223); Viewing is one click away; the menu lists only what a viewer can do.

artboards.label: 24 · Mixed kinds on one screen
artboards.note: Web fills the width and scrolls, posts fit, 9:16 video pillarboxes, print shows at the trim, 16:9 goes edge to edge.

artboards.label: 25 · Presenting with no internet
artboards.note: The missing clip holds its first frame for the audience; presenter view says why and offers Skip.

artboards.label: 26 · What esc does, everywhere
artboards.note: Menus close first; then one step back per mode; Image/Component close the picker; an annotation tool steps back to Hand, then to Edit (also when N C M A E S brought you there); switching mid-drag sets the drag down; esc never discards work.
